title: SynRM Torque Estimator
text: Estimate electromechanical torque and power, 6 inputs, 2 outputs, {Motor parameter input method} sets Type of motor; {Motor topology} sets the synchronous reluctance motor topology Synchronous reluctance, {Definition of d-axis and q-axis} sets the alignment of d - and q -axes Ld > Lq, {Number of pole pairs}, {D-axis current breakpoint vector, id (A)} sets the d-axis current lookup, {Q-axis current breakpoint vector, iq (A)} sets the q-axis current lookup, {Stator d-axis inductance, Ld (H)} sets the d-axis stator winding, {Stator q-axis inductance, Lq (H)} sets the q-axis stator winding, {Permanent magnet flux linkage, FluxPM (Wb)} sets the permanent magnet flux, {D-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxD(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the d-axis flux linkage lookup data, {Q-axis flux linkage LUT, FluxQ(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the q-axis flux linkage lookup data, {Ld LUT, Ld(id,iq) (H)} sets the d-axis inductance lookup data 0.9e-3 *, {Lq LUT, Lq(id,iq) (H)} sets the q-axis inductance lookup table data 0.15e-3 *, {PM flux linkage LUT, FluxPM(id,iq) (Wb)} sets the pM flux linkage lookup data 0.4e-4 * ones, {Input units} sets the unit of input values Per-Unit, {Base Voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage limit 24/sqrt, {Base Current (A)} sets the nominal current limit, {Base Speed (rpm)} sets the nominal speed limit, {Base torque (Nm)} sets the nominal torque limit, {Base power (W)} sets the nominal power limit and {Allow scaled-down motor parameters with CodeGen (higher precision with Fixed-Point data type)} scales down internal parameters to match per-unit. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Motor topology
params.values: Synchronous reluctance motor topology Synchronous reluctance motor (default) | PM-assisted synchronous reluctance motor

params.name: Definition of d-axis and q-axis
params.values: Alignment of d - and q -axes Ld > Lq (different from PMSM) (default) | Lq > Ld (same as PMSM)

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Motor parameter input method
params.values: Type of motor parameters Linear model with lumped parameters (default) | Non-linear model with D,Q-flux linkage LUTs | Non-linear model with Ld and Lq LUTs | Non-linear model with Ld, Lq, and FluxPM LUTs | Input port based Ld and Lq | Input port based Ld, Lq, and FluxPM

params.name: Ld LUT, Ld(id,iq) (H)
params.values: D-axis inductance lookup data 0.9e-3 * ones(4, 5) (default) | matrix

params.name: Lq LUT, Lq(id,iq) (H)
params.values: Q-axis inductance lookup table data 0.15e-3 * ones(4, 5) (default) | matrix

params.name: PM flux linkage LUT, FluxPM(id,iq) (Wb)
params.values: PM flux linkage lookup data 0.4e-4 * ones(4, 5) (default) | matrix

params.name: Input units
params.values: Unit of input values Per-Unit (PU) (default) | SI Units

params.name: Allow scaled-down motor parameters with CodeGen (higher precision with Fixed-Point data type)
params.values: Scale down internal parameters to match per-unit scale on (default) | off
